# diff

Compare text files or directory trees through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/diff first.txt second.txt

moonx cli/diff -u first.txt second.txt

moonx cli/diff -r old-dir new-dir
```

Produce normal, unified or context differences. Exit 0 for equal input, 1 for differences and 2 for errors.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-q`, `--brief` | Report only whether inputs differ. |
| `-u`, `--unified` | Select unified output. |
| `-c`, `--context` | Select context output. |
| `-i`, `--ignore-case` | Ignore ASCII case differences. |
| `-w`, `--ignore-all-space` | Ignore whitespace differences. |
| `-r`, `--recursive` | Compare directories recursively. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Inputs are retained in memory. Whitespace and case handling use the supported byte-oriented profile.
- Directory comparisons requiring unavailable device metadata are rejected; complete GNU directory semantics are not claimed.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
